kotha ko kshetrafal 40 barga meter ho.
messages.think: aayat ko kshetrafal = lambai x chaudai. 4 x 10 = 40 barga meter.

messages.content: yo bujhina, binita le 5 wata parikshya ma 78, 43, 82, 54, 43 ank lyayo. usko ausat ank kati ho?
binita ko ausat ank 60 ho.
messages.think: ausat = jamma / sankhya. jamma: 78 + 43 + 82 + 54 + 43 = 300. sankhya 5. 300 / 5 = 60.

messages.content: gurutwakarshan k ho?

gurutwakarshan bhaneko pindha bhayeka sabai chij le ek arka lai tanne bal ho. prithvi dherai thulo bhayeko le yasle sabai chij lai afno kendra tira tanchha, tyasaile hami le chhodeko kura tala khaschha. yahi bal le chandrama lai prithvi ko parikrama garauchha.
sochera bhannus: bikash nisha bhanda aglo chha. nisha binita bhanda aglo chha. binita dolma bhanda aglo chha. dolma prakash bhanda aglo chha. sabai bhanda aglo ko ho?
jawaf bikash ho.
messages.think: diyeka tathya lai ek line ma milauchhu (aglo bata suru): bikash > nisha > binita > dolma > prakash. sabai bhanda agadi bikash chha.

messages.content: 84125 bata 5173 ghataunus.
jawaf 78952 ho.
messages.think: yo ghatau ho, ek ko thau bata suru garchhu. ek ko thau: 5 - 3 = 2. das ko thau: 2 bata 7 ghatdaina, tyasaile agadi bata 1 saapat line: 12 - 7 = 5. saya ko thau: 0 bata 1 ghatdaina, tyasaile agadi bata 1 saapat line: 10 - 1 = 9. hajar ko thau: 3 bata 5 ghatdaina, tyasaile agadi bata 1 saapat line: 13 - 5 = 8. das hajar ko thau: 7 - 0 = 7. tyasaile 84125 - 5173 = 78952. jaach: 78952 + 5173 = 84125, milyo.

messages.content: euta farm ma kukhura ra bakhra chhan. jamma 18 wata tauko ra 56 wata khutta chhan. kati wata bakhra chhan?
10 wata bakhra ra 8 wata kukhura chhan.
messages.think: sabai 18 lai kukhura maandaa khutta: 18 x 2 = 36. tara jamma 56 chhan, farak: 56 - 36 = 20. har bakhra le kukhura bhanda 2 khutta badhi dinchha: 20 / 2 = 10. kukhura: 18 - 10 = 8. jaach: 8 x 2 + 10 x 4 = 56, milyo.
